# Lumen — Warp's Design System

> Lumen is Warp's vertically-integrated UI design system spanning web (Next.js 16 + Tailwind v4 + shadcn), React Native, native iOS/Android, native desktop (macOS/Windows), and e-commerce themes (Shopify Liquid, BigCommerce Stencil, WooCommerce). Tokens are DTCG JSON; build pipeline is Style Dictionary v5; component contracts follow the shadcn registry spec. Visual mood: **Quiet Industrial** — paper-warm white in light, Warp's actual navy ladder in dark, one disciplined Warp lime green accent (`#4ade80`) used for action / live / success only.

If you are an AI coding agent, read these in order:

## Core (read first)
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): Universal agent rules. Highest-priority hard rules for any work in this repo.
- [CLAUDE.md](/CLAUDE.md): Claude-specific addenda on top of AGENTS.md.
- [Token taxonomy](/design-system/01-tokens/README.md): Three-layer system (primitives → semantic → component). Engineers and LLMs only consume semantic.
- [Component schema](/design-system/02-components/_schema/component.schema.json): JSON schema every component contract validates against.
- [Synthesised brief](/research/lumen-brief.md): Why every major decision was made.

## Foundations
- [Principles](/design-system/00-foundations/principles.md): The five operating principles.
- [Voice & tone](/design-system/00-foundations/voice-and-tone.md): How Lumen sounds.
- [Accessibility](/design-system/00-foundations/accessibility.md): WCAG 2.2 AA floor — non-negotiable.
- [Motion language](/design-system/00-foundations/motion-language.md): Timing tokens, easing, choreography.
